overall_summary: Data shows clear audience leaning toward 'self respect' and smartphone-interaction micro-moments (chat apps, status lists, deleted texts) rather than generic late-night sadness. Content focused on boundaries and letting go outperforms abstract loneliness.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on concrete phone actions like deleting chats, muting pinned chats, or hiding status (e.g., rwOUYo_hayQ with 41 views, AfaLxMy6FMY with 40 views, wFimeeP_aVc with 35 views) perform noticeably better than abstract night thoughts.
winning_patterns.action: Continue framing emotional pain around modern smartphone habits and boundary-setting decisions.

weak_patterns.evidence: Vague themes like late-night tea, general waiting, or unspecific night thoughts (e.g., uIbMpCjVutQ with 5 views, Ct4R0He3BV4 with 7 views) suffer from low engagement due to lack of a tangible trigger.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely atmospheric hooks; anchor every story to a specific physical or digital artifact.
